release_notes: Testing release: new tables support 2–6 players. All 14 packs, eight setup rounds, six-player standings, round recap, history and tied award names fit without scrolling. Reveal uses available space before paging. Correct counts use natural integer wording. Content V7 keeps all 700 questions and 14 packs, with 397 light rewrites, four substantial clarifications and two pool-diversity improvements. Physical Android and subjective question review remain pending human testing.
